class.name: SteamSharedCloudFile
class.brief_description: Validated metadata and bounded bytes from a shared Steam Cloud file.

method.name: get_bytes
method.description: Returns the detached bytes copied from the Steam download.

method.name: get_handle
method.description: Returns the requested UGC handle as a canonical unsigned decimal string.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the validated logical filename reported by Steam.

method.name: get_owner_steam_id
method.description: Returns the owner SteamID64 as an unsigned decimal string, or an empty string when Steam supplies no owner.

members.member: Detached file bytes within the caller's requested limit.
The opaque UGC handle. Keep its unsigned decimal representation intact.
The validated logical Remote Storage name returned by Steam.
The SteamID64 of the sharing account when Steam reports it.
